name: OYAN
source: OYAN (AWAKEN) is an original psychological horror visual novel that immerses you in one of humanity’s most haunting legends. Inspired by the unforgettable image of the "mankurt" from the works of Chinghiz Aitmatov, the game explores the limits of human will under the terror of absolute loss of identity.
